note.title: Note
note.default: Computed over the scanned universe, not the whole exchange.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: Research and decision support only. This is not investment advice or a recommendation to buy or sell. Scores describe how a setup measures up against explicit rules on the data available at the time, and have not been shown to predict profit.

ResearchSummaryRead.title: ResearchSummaryRead
ResearchSummaryRead.description: Small payload for the dashboard: is research available and what was the latest run.

strategy_id.title: Strategy Id
strategy_id.description: Existing strategy, to include its backtest and paper record

ReviewRequest.title: ReviewRequest
ReviewRequest.description: A strategy setup to review. Used by the builder before the strategy is saved.

RiskComponent.title: RiskComponent
RiskComponent.description: One measured dimension of risk. `score` runs 0 (no concern) to 100 (severe); None means not assessed.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Analyse the market as it was at this time. Defaults to now.

risk_per_trade.title: Risk Per Trade
risk_per_trade.description: Fraction of capital risked per trade (0.01 = 1%)

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: Advice based on common good-practice guidelines. It does not predict profit, and you decide whether to run the strategy.
